features.name: Next Edit Suggestions
features.description: Copilot predicts the location and content of your next edit based on current changes, allowing quick navigation and acceptance with Tab.

features.name: Next Edit Suggestions Collapsed Mode
features.description: Collapsed display mode for Next Edit Suggestions showing only the suggestion indicator in the editor margin, with code revealed when navigating to it using Tab.

features.name: Edits
features.description: Make code changes across multiple files directly from chat with improved editor controls for accepting and discarding individual edits.

features.name: Agent Mode
features.description: Agent mode enables autonomous task completion by automatically searching workspace for context, editing files, checking for errors, and running terminal commands with user permission. Includes UX improvements like inline terminal commands, editable suggestions, and automatic build task execution.

features.name: Model Context Protocol server support
features.description: Support for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers in agent mode, offering a standardized method for AI models to discover and interact with external tools, applications, and data sources. Includes AI-assisted setup for Docker, npm, and PyPI packages, on-demand server startup, and discovery of existing MCP servers from Claude Desktop.

features.name: Thinking tool
features.description: Agent mode tool that gives models the opportunity to think between tool calls, improving performance on complex tasks and SWE-bench evaluations.

features.name: Fetch tool
features.description: Tool for including content from publicly accessible webpages in prompts. Works by rendering the webpage in a headless browser with cached data for repeated queries. Accessible via #fetch in agent mode or explicitly via #fetch with URL in other modes.

features.name: Usages tool
features.description: Tool combining Find All References, Find Implementation, and Go to Definition to help chat learn about functions, classes, or interfaces. Useful for finding sample implementations or identifying places to change during refactoring.

features.name: Create workspace with agent mode
features.description: Scaffold new workspaces in agent mode, including extensions, MCP servers, and other development environments with necessary dependencies and settings.

features.name: Extension tools in agent mode
features.description: Support for language model tools contributed by extensions in agent mode. Extensions can contribute tools via the language model tools API that can be enabled, disabled, and used in agent mode.

features.name: Agent mode tool approvals
features.description: Approval system for tools and terminal commands in agent mode with the ability to remember approvals at session, workspace, or application level. Includes experimental auto-approve setting for all tools.

features.name: Unified Chat view
features.description: Streamlined chat experience merging Chat and Copilot Edits views into one with three modes: Ask for questions, Edit for code editing across files, and Agent for autonomous coding. Enables switching modes mid-conversation, restoring past edit sessions, and running multiple agent sessions.

features.name: Bring Your Own Key (BYOK)
features.description: Allows Copilot Pro and Free users to bring their own API keys for providers like Azure, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, Ollama, and OpenRouter to use new models not natively supported by Copilot.

features.name: Edits Notebook Support
features.description: Use Copilot Edits to work with notebook files, including creating new notebooks, modifying content across multiple cells, inserting and deleting cells, and changing cell types. Includes new notebook tool, diff navigation, undo support, and cell output context attachment.

features.name: Build remote workspace index
features.description: Create high-quality remote workspace indexes managed by GitHub for faster @workspace results across large projects. Now includes instant indexing that automatically builds the index when first asking #codebase or @workspace questions.

features.name: Git changes context variable
features.description: Reference files modified in Git source control using the #changes context variable in Chat or Edits.

features.name: o3-mini
features.description: OpenAI's newest reasoning model offering advanced problem-solving capabilities for complex coding tasks.

features.name: Gemini 2.0 Flash
features.description: Google's latest model with high capabilities for code suggestions, documentation, and explaining code, available to all Copilot customers.

features.name: Auto model selection
features.description: Adds an Auto option in Copilot Chat that automatically routes requests to an appropriate model based on availability while honoring your model settings and policies.

features.name: Global instruction file
features.description: Tailor GitHub Copilot to provide chat responses and code suggestions aligned with your team's specific requirements using instruction files that can be configured globally or per workspace.

features.name: Prompt files
features.description: Ready-made prompts that can be reused locally or shared by putting them in the repository, enabling teams to standardize common Copilot interactions. Includes glob pattern support, autocompletion for filesystem paths, diagnostic information for broken links, and alignment with custom instructions.

features.name: User prompts
features.description: Personal prompts stored in the user data folder that can be synchronized across machines, similar to code snippets or user settings.

features.name: GPT-5.1
features.description: Advanced reasoning model for complex tasks with long-context understanding and fast generation.

features.name: GPT-5.1-Codex
features.description: Reasoning model optimized for high-quality code generation and editing.

features.name: GPT-5.1-Codex-Mini
features.description: Smaller, faster reasoning model tuned for efficient coding tasks.

features.name: GPT-5.1-Codex-Max
features.description: Most intelligent coding model optimized for long-horizon, agentic coding tasks.

features.name: GPT-5.2
features.description: Most capable model for professional knowledge work with significant improvements in general intelligence, long-context understanding, agentic tool-calling, and vision. Excels at creating spreadsheets, building presentations, writing code, and handling complex multi-step projects.

features.name: GPT-4.5
features.description: OpenAI's latest large language model designed with advanced capabilities in intuition, writing style, and broad knowledge.

features.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
features.description: Fast, cost-efficient model offering strong general intelligence and long-context support.

features.name: Claude Sonnet 4.5
features.description: Next-generation Claude Sonnet model offering stronger reasoning, coding, and multilingual capabilities across supported IDEs.

features.name: Claude Sonnet 3.5
features.description: Versatile high-intelligence model for reasoning, coding, and multilingual tasks.

features.name: Claude Opus 4.5
features.description: Advanced reasoning model for complex tasks requiring deep analysis and extended context understanding.

features.name: Claude 3.7 Sonnet
features.description: Claude 3.7 Sonnet with enhanced reasoning, coding, and multilingual capabilities. Supports both thinking and non-thinking modes with particularly strong improvements in agentic scenarios.

features.name: Raptor mini
features.description: Specialized model for fast, accurate code suggestions and explanations in everyday development tasks.

features.name: Gemini 3 Pro
features.description: Frontier multimodal model for rich visual understanding and interactive reasoning.

features.name: Gemini 3 Flash
features.description: Most intelligent model built for speed, combining frontier intelligence with superior search and grounding capabilities.

features.name: MCP registries (discovery)
features.description: Enables discovery of approved MCP servers via internal registries and allowlist controls across supported Copilot IDEs.

features.name: MCP registries (enforcement)
features.description: Lets administrators enforce registry-only MCP server usage, using allowlist governance policies.

features.name: Enhanced MCP OAuth support
features.description: Expands MCP OAuth authentication to support more identity providers with DCR and client-credentials flows.

features.name: Custom agents
features.description: Allows users and organizations to define reusable custom Copilot agents with tailored prompts, tools, and MCP servers across supported surfaces.

features.name: Advanced codebase search
features.description: Enhanced #codebase context variable that runs multiple tools including text search, file search, embeddings-based semantic search, Git modified files, project structure analysis, file reading, directory reading, and workspace symbol search.

features.name: Attach problems as context
features.description: Attach problems from the Problems panel to Copilot chat as context by dragging items, typing #problems, or using the paperclip button to help fix code issues.

features.name: Attach folders as context
features.description: Attach folders as context in Copilot chat by selecting the paperclip icon or typing #folder: followed by the folder name.

features.name: Change completions model
features.description: Select and change the language model used for inline code completions and suggestions via the Command Palette or Copilot menu.

features.name: Vision
features.description: Attach and interact with images in Copilot Chat prompts by dragging and dropping images from browsers or files, pasting from clipboard, or attaching screenshots of the IDE. Supports JPEG/JPG, PNG, GIF, WEBP, and BMP formats.

features.name: Pull request custom instructions
features.description: Provide custom instructions for generating pull request titles and descriptions to ensure consistency with team conventions.

features.name: OpenAI Codex integration
features.description: Integrates OpenAI Codex into the IDE.

features.name: Agent Sessions view
features.description: Adds an Agent Sessions view to manage local and cloud Copilot agent sessions from one interface.

features.name: Context-isolated sub-agents
features.description: Introduces context-isolated subagents so Copilot can run focused tasks in separate, optimized contexts.

features.name: Plan Mode
features.description: Adds Plan Mode, where Copilot creates and validates step-by-step implementation plans before writing code.

features.name: Delegate to Coding Agent
features.description: Lets you delegate coding tasks from Copilot Chat to Copilot coding agent, track progress while it runs in the background, and stay focused on other work while changes are made in the cloud.

features.name: Java & .NET app modernization
features.description: Brings GitHub Copilot app modernization workflows for Java and .NET into the IDE, enabling developers to assess applications, apply automated code transformations, remediate build and security issues, and containerize services without leaving their development environment.

features.name: Instruction files
features.description: Lets developers configure .instruction.md files for Copilot so it can follow specific guidelines and patterns when generating code.

features.name: Inline Chat
features.description: Brings Copilot inline chat interactions directly into the editor to chat about and modify code in place.

features.name: Drag file into context
features.description: Lets you drag a file from the editor tab into Copilot to quickly add it as context.

features.name: Inline code review
features.description: Introduces inline code review with Copilot so you can review and apply changes directly in the editor.

features.name: Open file tool in conversation agent
features.description: Adds an Open file tool to the Copilot chat conversation agent so it can open files directly from chat.

features.name: Hash context for files, folders, and tools
features.description: Enables # context references for files, folders, and tools in Copilot chat so you can quickly add them as context.

features.name: Sensitive file edit confirmation
features.description: Introduces a security confirmation step before Copilot edits sensitive files.

features.name: C++ code editing tools
features.description: Provides deep symbol awareness for C++ code editing with tools for viewing references across the codebase, understanding symbol metadata, visualizing class inheritance hierarchies, and tracing function call chains in agent mode.

features.name: GitHub repository search tool
features.description: Search for code snippets in any GitHub repository using the #githubRepo tool, which accepts a user/repo parameter to find specific implementations without opening the repository in the editor.

features.name: Extensions tool
features.description: Find and install Marketplace extensions directly from chat using the #extensions tool, which automatically invokes based on your prompt or can be explicitly referenced.

features.name: Autofix diagnostics in agent mode
features.description: Agent mode automatically detects and proposes follow-up edits to fix errors introduced by file edits, eliminating the need for manual follow-up prompts.

features.name: Attach UI elements to chat
features.description: Select and attach specific UI elements from web pages as context to chat using the built-in Simple Browser, including screenshots and associated HTML/CSS.

features.name: Task creation for new workspaces
features.description: At the end of workspace creation in agent mode, users are prompted to create and run a task for launching their app or project, streamlining the project launch process.

features.name: Alt text generation
features.description: Generate or update alt text for images in HTML and Markdown files by triggering quick fixes on lines containing embedded images.

features.name: Notebook tools for agent mode
features.description: Agent mode includes tools for running notebook cells, getting kernel state with active variables, and listing/installing packages into the notebook environment.

features.name: Python Environments chat tools
features.description: Chat tools for getting Python environment information and installing packages, with automatic environment detection based on file or workspace context.

features.name: Chat mode keyboard shortcuts
features.description: Keyboard shortcuts for opening Chat view in specific modes, including Ctrl+Shift+I for agent mode and commands for each mode (ask, edit, agent).
